decisions.statement: The port and the host names are read off the service's page by its slug.
A page stating no port ends the run rather than leaving a service that answers nothing.
A host name that will not bind ends the run, for the service to start again.
A round is asked for at one path, and nothing is asked for at another.
A round is asked for by POST rather than by another method.
A body that is no JSON object is refused rather than read as naming no check.
A body naming no check asks for every check that runs at audit.
A body naming checks asks for those checks and no other.
A name in that list that is no string is refused rather than dropped.
What the round answered is the whole of what comes back.
Nothing here says which checks there are.
Nothing here runs a check or writes a verdict.
Importing this module's file binds nothing.

definition: the port a round of the audit is asked for on, and what answers there
